title: Génération de données de synthèse de sinistres et descriptions en LLM
summary: A Master's (Master 2) generative-AI project that synthesizes automobile insurance claims data to improve pricing models, combining generative tabular models with XGBoost validation and a local LLM for text descriptions. It runs SDV's CTGANSynthesizer and TVAESynthesizer (via sdv.single_table) with SingleTableMetadata to fit and sample synthetic insurance claim records for data augmentation.
